note: Mid slice of English Renaissance and Jacobean viol-consort music and early ensemble music. Era is 'baroque' for all (vocabulary has no earlier era). Method: IMSLP wikitext for scoring/dates; floor evidence from Deezer and Apple track lists (album ids in sources); recordings matched by title, and for numbered pieces by VdGS number. Lupo: Fretwork's complete Lupo disc (Signum 2022) numbers pieces by VdGS number within each part-count; IMSLP's 'VdGS 3.n' was read as three-part No. n (supported by Serna's VdGS 15 and 26); the 14 pieces added from Fretwork's disc point at IMSLP's collection pages (gap). Holborne: the 1599 print names viols first, so the outOfScope pages (unspecified instruments) were checked: 8 pieces added with their own pages, 9 more from the collection page (gap); the other pieces, known only by IAH numbers, not matched. Cranford: only LeStrange Viols (New Focus FCR905, 2015) record him (the label calls it the premiere recording of nearly all his consort music); its track list gave the six-part fantasias, two pavans, In Nomine and Go from my Window (no IMSLP page for them in this slice). Weelkes Pavan No. 6 and the Fantasia of Six Parts are recorded only on cornetts and sackbuts; the owner may rule on whether that passes the floor for a viol entry. Weelkes's In Nomine numbering is uncertain: the Rose Consort (Regent 2023) record two five-part In Nomines, IMSLP has one four-part and one five-part. Hume: the three-viol pieces are recorded (Naxos, Savall, Labyrinto) but the recordings' forces were not checked; kept at medium confidence. Not confirmed although IMSLP flags 'recorded': Ford, Simmes, Mundy, Lanier, Lupo 3.16, Ferrabosco's In Nomines (no matching track on Deezer or Apple; the Naxos Music Library was not searchable; Mundy's Naxos track is an In Nomine called 'Fantasia'). Unspecified-instrument prints (Gervaise, Massaino, Schuyt, Sommer, Gabrieli's Sacrae symphoniae) skipped; Simpson's and Praetorius's prints are entered as sets with violins as alternatives. Other In Nomines (Tye's 21, Parsons's 4, Mundy's, Ferrabosco's 2) are on outOfScope pages for unspecified instruments and were not added beyond the five Tye pieces that have viol pages.
